headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive H1/H2s. Bold is for impact, Light is for elegance.

body.usage: Use loose leading (leading-relaxed) for readable paragraph content.

accent_mono.usage: Use for overlines, labels, numbering (e.g., manifesto chapters), and tiny tech details. tracking-[0.2em] uppercase.

glassmorphism.note: Use this strictly for floating headers, over-image cards, and sticky elements. Must have the 1px inner border to look like milled crystal.

visual_enhancers.spotlight_treatment: Images should have a radial gradient overlay or soft shadow glow to mimic a spotlight hitting them in a dark room.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle grain/noise overlay fixed to the viewport (`pointer-events-none`) to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.

Hero.layout: Massive 100vh layout. Central text. Subtle 3D or parallax background element.
Hero.motion: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Use `overflow-hidden` on line wrappers and translate text `y: 100% -> 0` with framer-motion.
Hero.features: Cinematic dark abstract background. Subtle scroll down indicator.

Editorial_Marquee.features: Massive outline text or elegant brand/client list separated by asterisks or bullets.

About.layout: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. 1 large portrait, adjacent text blocks.
About.features: Cinematic portrait in a clipped frame with a subtle monochrome filter or dark spotlight.

Past_Product_Work.layout: Staggered overlapping images or wide cinematic frames.
Past_Product_Work.motion: Parallax scroll on images (images move slightly slower than the container).
Past_Product_Work.features: Real product photography treated with spotlight/clipped frames. Dark theme mockups.

Case_Studies.layout: Liquid-glass cards in a responsive grid. High internal padding (p-8 or p-12).
Case_Studies.motion: Hover states lift the card and increase border opacity. Scroll reveal per card.
Case_Studies.features: Deep dark cards with vibrant hover accents (Electric Cyan/Pink glow).

Product_Improvement_Manifesto.layout: Numbered list layout. Mono font for massive chapter numbers (01, 02, 03).
Product_Improvement_Manifesto.motion: Staggered reveal of chapters on scroll.
Product_Improvement_Manifesto.features: High contrast. Stark white text against black. Accent color used sparingly on the numbers.

Side_Projects.layout: Dense bento grid or list view. Technical feel.
Side_Projects.features: Glassmorphism tags. Mono typography for tech stack.

Contact.layout: Massive footer. Massive text for CTA (e.g., text-[10vw]).
Contact.motion: Magnetic button effect on the primary CTA.
Contact.features: Minimal input fields if any, or a simple mailto link dressed up elegantly.

grids_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-32 for section padding. Tension and negative space are key.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetric spanning (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).

motion_language.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY. Initialize Lenis at the root layout.
motion_language.on_load: Signature kinetic reveal. Masked text lines rising up, staggering by 0.1s. Easing: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion_language.scroll_reveal: Elements fade in and translate Y by 40px when 20% in view.
motion_language.micro_interactions: Buttons have scale-down effect on tap. Hover reveals subtle glow or tracing beam.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark gradients or text-shadow. Vibrant accents must pass 3:1 against #050505.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Disable heavy parallax if true.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_background.description: Dark abstract liquid glass for cinematic hero background.

product_work_2.description: MacBook Pro turned on, neon accents.

case_study_1.description: Person holding glowing smartphone in the dark.

case_study_2.description: Glowing laptop edge in the dark.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required libraries: `yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis lucide-react react-fast-marquee`.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out of the box if they feel 'SaaS-like'. Strip the generic styling and apply liquid-glass styling.
Create a React layout component that initializes Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling globally.
For the hero on-load reveal, create a component that splits the text into lines, wraps each line in a div with `overflow-hidden`, and animates the inner text from `y: 100%` to `y: 0`.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for the marquee if you need logos, or just use large outline text typography for an editorial feel.
Implement the numbered manifesto with huge '01', '02' in JetBrains Mono, placed alongside body text.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header. Use `bg-black/60` with `backdrop-blur-xl` and `border-b border-white/10`.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and negative space.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.
